title: Forward scan of the comparator
statement: Let $w,u,v$ be Boolean words and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $w$. For every $j\le\max(|u|,|v|)$, after $j$ steps from the comparator's scan phase with register true and both word-tape heads at zero, it remains in the scan phase, its register records whether the length-$j$ prefixes of $u$ and $v$ are equal, and both heads are at displacement $j$.
replaced:
For every $j \le \max(\abs{u}, \abs{v})$, after $j$ forward steps of the
comparator the equality register records exactly whether the length-$j$
prefixes of $u$ and $v$ agree, with both heads at $j$; this includes
mismatches caused by unequal lengths.
